variant: second generation: autonomous tandem rollers and large-width pavers
name: XCMG unmanned road construction cluster (autonomous rollers and pavers)
specialisedFor: asphalt and subgrade compaction with driverless rollers
summary: Fleet of driverless XCMG tandem rollers and asphalt pavers guided by BeiDou satellite positioning, inertial navigation and obstacle radar that pave and compact road layers without operators in the cabs. XCMG says the second generation has worked on 15 highway projects in 12 Chinese provinces.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU offer for the unmanned versions found; the projects named are all in China. XCMG sells conventional road machines in Europe, but no source read offers the driverless cluster outside China.

specs.label: Highway projects with second-generation cluster
specs.conditions: 12 provinces, about 500 km in total (maker, May 2022)
specs.quote: the company's second-generation unmanned cluster construction equipment has participated in 15 highway construction projects that cover 12 provinces across China

specs.label: Roller control accuracy
specs.conditions: improved from 20 cm with new inertial navigation alignment

specs.label: Efficiency gain vs. manned rollers
specs.quote: The unmanned construction rollers reduced fuel consumption by 15%, improving efficiency by 20%.

specs.label: Fleet on Nanjing–Shanghai expressway
specs.value: 10 autonomous tandem rollers and 2 unmanned large-width pavers
specs.quote: XCMG put ten autonomous tandem rollers and two unmanned large-width pavers to work on the resurfacing project

specs.label: Asphalt thickness radar
specs.quote: enabling measurement of surface thickness to a depth of 120mm and with an accuracy of plus or minus 1mm

specs.label: Positioning
specs.value: BeiDou satellite reference station, inertial navigation, obstacle recognition
specs.quote: with the fleet controlled by the BeiDou satellite positioning reference station

notes: A fleet of conventional road machines made driverless: tandem rollers roll on steel drums (counted as wheels here); paver undercarriage not stated.
Machine models in the fleet are not named in the sources read.
Tool = roller drums and paver screed.

evidence.task: Ten driverless tandem rollers and two unmanned pavers resurfaced a section of a busy expressway
evidence.where: Nanjing-Shanghai expressway maintenance, Jiangsu, China (Jiangsu Xiandai Road & Bridge Company)
evidence.note: Called the largest unmanned road construction fleet so far.

evidence.task: Second-generation cluster used on 15 highway projects, including subgrade compaction on Jingxiong, Panda and Xinliunan expressways
evidence.where: 12 provinces in China, incl. Xinjiang S21 desert expressway
